_comment: Midrapidity charged-particle density dN_ch/deta (|eta|<0.5 unless noted) vs centrality, and the longitudinal shape. Sources: ALICE PRL 116 (2016) 222302 arXiv:1512.06104 (Pb-Pb 5.02); ALICE arXiv:1910.07678 Tab. 5 (0-5, 5-10); ALICE PLB 772 (2017) 567 arXiv:1612.08966 (80-90, total N_ch); ALICE PLB 726 (2013) 610 arXiv:1304.0347 (2.76 TeV shape fit); ALICE arXiv:2504.02505 (5.36 TeV); ALICE PLB 790 (2019) 35 arXiv:1805.04432 (Xe-Xe); PHOBOS PRC 83 (2011) 024913 arXiv:1011.1940 (Au-Au 200/62.4/19.6, |eta|<1); CMS arXiv:2606.02285 (O-O). See docs/physics/03-final-state-data.md. Added 2026-09-23 from PHENIX PRC 93 (2016) 024901 arXiv:1509.06727 (Tables VIII-XXXIV, |eta|<0.35, 0-5%), ALICE arXiv:1307.6796 Table 1 (p-Pb V0A classes, |eta_lab|<0.5), ATLAS arXiv:2606.20257 HEPData ins3170344 (Ne-Ne, pT>0 extrapolated; 0-5% = average of the 1% bins).

shape.source: ALICE 1304.0347 fit at 2.76 TeV, rescaled by dN/deta(0)

PbPb_2760._note: 0-5% = 1601 +/- 60 (ALICE 1012.1657); other bins from ALICE PRL 106 032301 Table 1 [values transcribed from the 2.76 TeV centrality paper; verify against HEPData ins880049]

shape.source: PHOBOS 1011.1940: FWHM 7.1 at 130 GeV, ~7.6 at 200 GeV [interpolated, not verified]; limiting fragmentation near y_beam = 5.36

AuAu_20._note: key uses round(19.6)=20 (glauber.system_key); was mis-keyed as AuAu_19 before 2026-09-23

shape.source: FWHM approximated by 2*y_beam*0.87 scaling of PHOBOS 19.6 GeV (4.8 at y_beam=3.04) [approximate]
interpolated between PHOBOS 19.6 and 62.4 GeV FWHM [approximate]
interpolated between PHOBOS 19.6 and 62.4 GeV FWHM [approximate]

pPb_5020._note: ALICE V0A (Pb-going side) multiplicity classes; the model's p-Pb centrality comes from Glauber impact-parameter quantiles, which correlate only loosely with V0A classes

shape.source: Pb-Pb shape assumed; the real p-Pb dN/deta is asymmetric (ALICE 1412.6828 Fig. 16) [approximate]
Au-Au 200 GeV width assumed; real d-Au dN/deta is asymmetric [approximate]
